BackstoryDef.title: minor house heir
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to recite thirty generations of family before learning to swim. Tutors came and went on a schedule, and every small failure was entered in a book that [PAWN_possessive] grandparents read.

BackstoryDef.title: Auridon dock brat
BackstoryDef.description: Not every Altmer is raised in a tower. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up around the ships at Firsthold, carrying cargo for captains who pretended not to see [PAWN_objective], and picked up foreign words along with a low opinion of foreigners.

BackstoryDef.title: College foundling
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was left at the College of Sapiarchs with a sealed letter nobody ever explained. The archivists raised [PAWN_objective] between their other duties, and [PAWN_pronoun] could find any scroll in the building by age ten.

BackstoryDef.title: Thalmor agent
BackstoryDef.description: For years [PAWN_nameDef] reported on merchants, priests and occasionally on other agents. The work suited [PAWN_objective] until the day [PAWN_possessive] own name appeared on the wrong list.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion marine
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served aboard the Dominion's fleet, boarding pirate galleys off Pyandonea and landing wherever the admirals pointed. Decades at sea left a good sword arm and no fondness for boats.

BackstoryDef.title: Alinor battlemage
BackstoryDef.description: The army of Alinor taught [PAWN_nameDef] to throw fire in formation, on command, and to keep doing it once the other side started throwing it back. Most of [PAWN_possessive] class did not reach retirement.

BackstoryDef.title: disgraced sapiarch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] published a history that disagreed with the wrong family. A century of scholarship was struck from the College's records in an afternoon, and leaving Summerset seemed wiser than arguing.

BackstoryDef.title: Sunhold factor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed trade for a noble house out of Sunhold, buying grain, selling glass and keeping two sets of accounts. Foreign buyers always assumed the second set was the honest one.

BackstoryDef.title: topiary keeper
BackstoryDef.description: The gardens of Summerset are shaped over lifetimes, and [PAWN_nameDef] spent one of them on a single hedge wall outside Shimmerene. It is, by any fair measure, a very good hedge.

BackstoryDef.title: ceremony page
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried cushions at Crystal Tower functions, and learned early that the order of a procession could end a family's fortunes.

BackstoryDef.title: Lillandril vintner's child
BackstoryDef.description: The family grew grapes on terraces older than most human kingdoms. [PAWN_nameDef] could name the slope a wine came from by smell, a talent nobody ever asked to see outside of dinner.

BackstoryDef.title: raid orphan
BackstoryDef.description: Maormer raiders burned the village when [PAWN_nameDef] was small. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up in a navy hostel, sleeping under the portraits of admirals.

BackstoryDef.title: glassblower's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Summerset glass is not actually made of anything so ordinary. [PAWN_nameDef] swept the workshop for six years before being allowed near the furnace.

BackstoryDef.title: rejected candidate
BackstoryDef.description: Every child in the family sat the examination for the Sapiarchs. [PAWN_nameDef] failed it twice and heard about it for the rest of [PAWN_possessive] youth.

BackstoryDef.title: stargazer's ward
BackstoryDef.description: An old astronomer at Skywatch took [PAWN_nameDef] in to mind the instruments. They spent their nights charting the constellations and their days asleep.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion censor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] read other people's books for a living and inked out the parts that were inconvenient. Eventually [PAWN_pronoun] knew more forbidden history than anyone alive, and that became a problem of its own.

BackstoryDef.title: court herald
BackstoryDef.description: No name at court was ever mispronounced on [PAWN_nameDef]'s watch. Three duels and a minor war have been avoided that way, or so [PAWN_pronoun] claims.

BackstoryDef.title: temple physician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served at a temple infirmary in Cloudrest, tending nobles who were mostly unwell from boredom. The rare real wound was almost a relief.

BackstoryDef.title: tower mason
BackstoryDef.description: Altmeri towers are expected to stand for ten thousand years, and [PAWN_nameDef] takes that specification personally. [PAWN_pronoun] has torn down a finished wall over a thumb's width.

BackstoryDef.title: marble sculptor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent thirty years carving a likeness of a patron who died before it was finished. The heirs refused to pay, and the statue still stands in a warehouse in Alinor.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion envoy
BackstoryDef.description: Sent to Elsweyr to smooth over trade disputes, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to sit through a Khajiiti negotiation without once showing what [PAWN_pronoun] thought of it.

BackstoryDef.title: fleet navigator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] plotted courses through the Abecean for the Dominion fleet. Being wrong out there tends to be a once-in-a-lifetime mistake, and [PAWN_pronoun] has not made it.

BackstoryDef.title: Justiciar inquisitor
BackstoryDef.description: A polite knock and a list of questions: that was [PAWN_nameDef]'s whole method. Most people answered before the second knock.

BackstoryDef.title: wall archer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded the sea walls at Sunhold through a whole century of nothing happening, followed by a very bad week.

BackstoryDef.title: Great War veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] marched on the Imperial City and later walked back from it. Nobody at home wants to discuss the second part.

BackstoryDef.title: honor duelist
BackstoryDef.description: Noble houses are forbidden from open feuds, so they hire people like [PAWN_nameDef] to settle things on their behalf at dawn, with all the proper paperwork.

BackstoryDef.title: failed Psijic novice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once spent a season on Artaeum, or thinks [PAWN_pronoun] did. The island has since made it clear [PAWN_pronoun] will not find it again.

BackstoryDef.title: court enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] put wards on jewelry, doorways and once a very nervous duke. The work paid well and the clients rarely understood what they had bought.

BackstoryDef.title: theater illusionist
BackstoryDef.description: The stages of Shimmerene like their dragons convincing. [PAWN_nameDef] once made an audience flee a playhouse and was given a bonus for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Order of Mages hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Since Mannimarco, Summerset has kept a quiet office for the pursuit of necromancers. [PAWN_nameDef] worked there and has dug up more graves than most of the people [PAWN_pronoun] hunted.

BackstoryDef.title: exiled archivist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] copied the wrong page, kept the copy, and left Alinor at night with it sewn into [PAWN_possessive] coat.

BackstoryDef.title: Crystal Tower page
BackstoryDef.description: Carrying scrolls up the Crystal Tower left [PAWN_nameDef] with strong legs and a low opinion of stairs. Nobody ever explained what the scrolls said.

BackstoryDef.title: Cloudrest kite flyer
BackstoryDef.description: The winds around Cloudrest will take anything that weighs less than a child. [PAWN_nameDef] built kites from old parchment and lost most of them over the sea.

BackstoryDef.title: Shimmerene chorister
BackstoryDef.description: Shimmerene wanted its children singing before they could read. [PAWN_nameDef] was given a place in the third row and told to keep [PAWN_possessive] chin up.

BackstoryDef.title: Dusk garrison child
BackstoryDef.description: Dusk has always been the island's unfashionable corner. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up between its barracks and learned to swear in three dialects.

BackstoryDef.title: Skywatch stable hand
BackstoryDef.description: Horses at Skywatch were better bred than most people in Cyrodiil, and [PAWN_nameDef] was reminded of this every morning while shoveling after them.

BackstoryDef.title: lineage reciter
BackstoryDef.description: By six, [PAWN_nameDef] could recite forty generations of ancestors without pausing. The family took guests to the parlor just to hear it.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea Elf raid survivor
BackstoryDef.description: Maormer ships came out of the fog when [PAWN_nameDef] was small. Afterward the village was four houses shorter, and the child slept with a bow nearby.

BackstoryDef.title: tutor's despair
BackstoryDef.description: Eleven tutors resigned over [PAWN_nameDef]. The twelfth took to locking the door, which only taught the child about locks.

BackstoryDef.title: Alinor market child
BackstoryDef.description: In the lower markets of Alinor, [PAWN_nameDef] sold candied fruit to people who would never have looked down far enough to see the seller.

BackstoryDef.title: Firsthold orchard child
BackstoryDef.description: Each year, Firsthold's orchards were judged for symmetry as well as yield. [PAWN_nameDef] spent long afternoons pruning trees that already looked perfect.

BackstoryDef.title: Auridon fisher's child
BackstoryDef.description: The nets came in full or they did not, and no amount of ancestry changed the result. Auridon's shore taught [PAWN_nameDef] that much early.

BackstoryDef.title: Phynaster pilgrim
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] parents walked the old route of Phynaster, who supposedly taught the Altmer to live a hundred years longer. [PAWN_nameDef] mostly remembers the blisters.

BackstoryDef.title: Salache-born child
BackstoryDef.description: Mother's kin and father's kin were both Altmer, and neither side would admit the other was. [PAWN_nameDef] was raised among the salache of Auridon with two sets of manners.

BackstoryDef.title: lamp trimmer
BackstoryDef.description: Every lamp in the archive had to burn without smoke. [PAWN_nameDef] trimmed wicks at dusk and read whatever had been left open on the tables.

BackstoryDef.title: garden statue cleaner
BackstoryDef.description: With a soft brush and a bucket, [PAWN_nameDef] washed bird droppings off the likeness of a dead ancestor. A good view of fine stonework came free with the work.

BackstoryDef.title: younger twin
BackstoryDef.description: Being a few minutes late cost [PAWN_nameDef] the title, the inheritance and the good bedroom. The younger twin made up for it with a talent for grudges.

BackstoryDef.title: Justiciar's child
BackstoryDef.description: Children in a Justiciar's house learned to listen at dinner. [PAWN_nameDef] once reported an uncle for an offhand joke and got a sweet for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Bangkorai exile's child
BackstoryDef.description: A family that fled the Dominion is still a family with opinions about the Dominion. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up abroad hearing about a home no one could return to.

BackstoryDef.title: Sapiarch's copyist
BackstoryDef.description: Mistakes in a copied treatise were corrected with a rap across the knuckles. [PAWN_nameDef] developed lovely handwriting and very careful fingers.

BackstoryDef.title: cloud reader
BackstoryDef.description: An old gardener taught [PAWN_nameDef] to tell the coming weather from the sky over the Sea of Pearls. The forecasts were right about half the time.

BackstoryDef.title: Crystal-Like-Law student
BackstoryDef.description: Lessons at school covered the fall of Aldmeris, the superiority of Aldmeri blood and proper posture. [PAWN_nameDef] was excellent at posture.

BackstoryDef.title: shipwright's child
BackstoryDef.description: Swan-prowed ships took shape over years in the yards of Lillandril. [PAWN_nameDef] held the plumb line and was eventually trusted with a chisel.

BackstoryDef.title: cook's helper
BackstoryDef.description: There are nineteen correct ways of serving a pear, according to the kitchen where [PAWN_nameDef] grew up. Anyone who knew only eighteen ate last.

BackstoryDef.title: Auri-El acolyte
BackstoryDef.description: Dawn services at the temple of Auri-El started before the sun, a point of theology [PAWN_nameDef] never fully appreciated at age nine.

BackstoryDef.title: Syrabane's admirer
BackstoryDef.description: After hearing about Syrabane's ring at Solitude, [PAWN_nameDef] spent a whole summer casting imaginary spells at the household cat. The cat took no lasting harm.

BackstoryDef.title: sickly heir
BackstoryDef.description: Fevers kept [PAWN_nameDef] in bed through most of childhood, with a window, a stack of histories and an aunt who visited to check on the will.

BackstoryDef.title: Oblivion Crisis orphan
BackstoryDef.description: Summerset's ports burned in the same years as Cyrodiil's, whatever the histories now prefer to say. [PAWN_nameDef] came through it with no relatives left.

BackstoryDef.title: net mender's child
BackstoryDef.description: Rope burn and salt were the first things [PAWN_nameDef] knew. Everything else about Summerset's famous beauty happened farther up the hill.

BackstoryDef.title: gull hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Gulls stole from the drying racks, so [PAWN_nameDef] was handed a short bow and told to sort it out. Results were mixed, but dinner improved.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain shepherd
BackstoryDef.description: Goats do not care about ancestry. On the high pastures above Sunhold, [PAWN_nameDef] spent several happy years with nobody correcting [PAWN_possessive] vowels.

BackstoryDef.title: temple foundling
BackstoryDef.description: Someone left a basket on the steps at Lillandril. The priests raised [PAWN_nameDef] kindly and never stopped wondering aloud who the parents were.

BackstoryDef.title: mosaic setter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] set tiles the size of a fingernail in a floor the family had started two hundred years earlier. It would be finished eventually.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion ward
BackstoryDef.description: When a house fell out of favor, its children became wards of the Dominion. [PAWN_nameDef] learned gratitude at a state school and practiced it loudly.

BackstoryDef.title: tidepool collector
BackstoryDef.description: Starfish, shell, and a very unhappy crab all ended up labeled on a shelf in [PAWN_nameDef]'s room. The family assumed a career in natural philosophy.

BackstoryDef.title: bellringer's child
BackstoryDef.description: The bells of Sunhold rang the hours, and [PAWN_nameDef] rang them when the old sexton's shoulders failed. A slight deafness on the left side remains.

BackstoryDef.title: duel second's child
BackstoryDef.description: A parent's work was carrying swords to dawn appointments and making polite conversation with the bereaved. [PAWN_nameDef] went along from an early age.

BackstoryDef.title: tax clerk's child
BackstoryDef.description: Evenings at home meant checking sums at the kitchen table. By ten, [PAWN_nameDef] could find a false entry and knew better than to mention it to the wrong person.

BackstoryDef.title: stolen sweets thief
BackstoryDef.description: An entire festival's worth of honey cakes vanished from a Canonreeve's table, and [PAWN_nameDef] was never charged. Most of the cakes were later found under a bed.

BackstoryDef.title: harbor pilot's child
BackstoryDef.description: Reefs around Summerset can gut a warship. [PAWN_nameDef] learned their names as other children learned rhymes, riding in the bow of a pilot boat.

BackstoryDef.title: Artaeum dreamer
BackstoryDef.description: Islanders still talk about Artaeum as if it might come back into view. [PAWN_nameDef] looked for it from the cliffs every evening and once claimed to have seen it.

BackstoryDef.title: courtier's shadow
BackstoryDef.description: Standing silently behind a chair was a real job at court. [PAWN_nameDef] held that job at eight, overhearing things that later ended careers.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion archer
BackstoryDef.description: Battlefields from Elden Root to the Imperial City saw [PAWN_nameDef] in the third rank, loosing on a whistle and never once told why this particular hill mattered.

BackstoryDef.title: Thalmor headsman
BackstoryDef.description: Sentences of the Thalmor were usually read in private. [PAWN_nameDef] carried them out in private as well, and was paid on the first of each month.

BackstoryDef.title: Summerset marine
BackstoryDef.description: Boarding Maormer ships takes a certain patience with being shot at. Twenty years aboard the eagle fleet gave [PAWN_nameDef] plenty of it.

BackstoryDef.title: Skywatch cavalry officer
BackstoryDef.description: The cavalry of Skywatch rode beautifully and charged rarely. [PAWN_nameDef] saw one real charge, on a wet field in Hammerfell, and does not recommend it.

BackstoryDef.title: Sunhold garrison sergeant
BackstoryDef.description: Young nobles came to Sunhold to serve a fashionable year in uniform. [PAWN_nameDef] was the sergeant who stopped them from hurting themselves.

BackstoryDef.title: Fort Greenwall survivor
BackstoryDef.description: The Dominion's Valenwood garrisons were not as welcome as the pamphlets claimed. [PAWN_nameDef] learned that during a very long night at a burning fort.

BackstoryDef.title: Red Ring prisoner
BackstoryDef.description: After the Red Ring was closed around the Imperial City, things went badly for elves who were caught outside. [PAWN_nameDef] came home a year later, thinner and much less patient.

BackstoryDef.title: Sentinel siege engineer
BackstoryDef.description: During the Hammerfell campaigns, [PAWN_nameDef] dug the trenches, aimed the catapults and sent a careful report about the Redguards who would not stop fighting.

BackstoryDef.title: embassy guard
BackstoryDef.description: Standing at the door of a Dominion embassy means being spat at in many languages. [PAWN_nameDef] kept a straight face through all of them and a list of names.

BackstoryDef.title: Maormer hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sailed with the squadrons that chased Sea Elf raiders around Pyandonea's fog banks. A snake-carved prow still hangs on a wall somewhere as proof.

BackstoryDef.title: sword-singer of Alinor
BackstoryDef.description: Fencing masters in Alinor insisted the form had to be beautiful or it did not count. Several dead opponents have been unable to argue the matter with [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: bodyguard to a Canonreeve
BackstoryDef.description: Canonreeves make plenty of enemies for people with so little real power. For thirty years, [PAWN_nameDef] walked one step behind a particularly unpopular one.

BackstoryDef.title: courier of the Dominion
BackstoryDef.description: Messages between Auridon and the mainland went by ship, horse, and whoever was left alive. [PAWN_nameDef] rode the last dangerous part more times than was reasonable.

BackstoryDef.title: sea wall captain
BackstoryDef.description: Captaining a stretch of Firsthold's sea wall is mostly about mortar and rotas. Then the raiders come, and [PAWN_nameDef] finally got to justify the rotas.

BackstoryDef.title: deserter from Elsweyr
BackstoryDef.description: Two Moons Dance was not supposed to be a war [PAWN_nameDef] had any part in. One night the sentry simply walked south and kept walking.

BackstoryDef.title: tournament archer
BackstoryDef.description: Prizes for marksmanship paid better than service in the Dominion. [PAWN_nameDef] toured from one festival to the next, smiling and shooting apples.

BackstoryDef.title: Sapiarch of Labor
BackstoryDef.description: The Sapiarchs of Labor study how a spell should be applied to a thing that must be done. [PAWN_nameDef] wrote the definitive monograph on self-repairing sea walls.

BackstoryDef.title: Sapiarch of Transmutation
BackstoryDef.description: One of [PAWN_nameDef]'s early experiments turned a bucket of iron nails into slightly worse iron nails. The later ones were good enough to get expelled over.

BackstoryDef.title: Psijic correspondent
BackstoryDef.description: Letters from Artaeum arrive rarely and do not bother with a reason. [PAWN_nameDef] was among the few mages still receiving them, and never admitted to sending any back.

BackstoryDef.title: College of Sapiarchs lecturer
BackstoryDef.description: Lectures in the Crystal Tower run six hours and allow no questions. [PAWN_nameDef] considered that a generous format and regretted having to stop for meals.

BackstoryDef.title: storm caller of Cloudrest
BackstoryDef.description: Cloudrest stands so high that its mages learn lightning from close range. [PAWN_nameDef] has a pale burn down one arm from the first lesson.

BackstoryDef.title: Lillandril alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody in Lillandril grows old in a way they can't afford to hide. [PAWN_nameDef] brewed the remedies that made this possible and billed accordingly.

BackstoryDef.title: necromancy inspector
BackstoryDef.description: Necromancy is an embarrassing subject on Summerset, so the Dominion sends someone quietly. [PAWN_nameDef] was the one who opened the crypts and took careful notes.

BackstoryDef.title: ship-mage
BackstoryDef.description: Calming seas, filling sails and setting Maormer rigging on fire made up the three chapters of [PAWN_nameDef]'s working life. Land still feels too still.

BackstoryDef.title: wardsmith of Dusk
BackstoryDef.description: Dusk's outer walls carry wards older than the Dominion, and each one wears thin. [PAWN_nameDef] walked the length of them yearly with a hammer and a headache.

BackstoryDef.title: Mages Guild defector
BackstoryDef.description: Vanus Galerion left Summerset because he thought magic should be for everyone. [PAWN_nameDef] joined his Guild, then quit it for the opposite reason, and neither side forgives the turn.

BackstoryDef.title: anatomist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years proving that Altmer and Men were built on a different plan. The dissections proved something else, and the paper went unpublished.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion battle-healer
BackstoryDef.description: Field hospitals in the Great War took in the wounded by the wagonload. [PAWN_nameDef] sorted them by who could still fight, which is the part nobody writes about.

BackstoryDef.title: illusion tutor
BackstoryDef.description: Rich children paid [PAWN_nameDef] to teach them how to look taller and wiser at a party. Oddly, none of them ever needed to be taught to look bored.

BackstoryDef.title: conjurer of the Sixth Order
BackstoryDef.description: Summoning a Daedra is simple, as [PAWN_nameDef] will happily explain. What takes study is getting the thing to go back afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: court astrologer
BackstoryDef.description: Royal births, dull weddings and the sailing of the fleet all waited on [PAWN_nameDef]'s charts. The stars tended to agree with whoever paid for the reading.

BackstoryDef.title: Ayleid scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent decades in Cyrodiil's ruins, translating Ayleid inscriptions and insisting that the builders were simply misunderstood. Few people asked the slaves.

BackstoryDef.title: Alinor archmage's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: For forty years, [PAWN_nameDef] served as apprentice to one archmage, a span that included a lot of soup. The old mer did eventually teach a spell or two.

BackstoryDef.title: enchanter of swan ships
BackstoryDef.description: Each swan ship carries enchantments worked into the wood during building. [PAWN_nameDef] signed them all in a small script hidden below the waterline.

BackstoryDef.title: Shimmerene dyer
BackstoryDef.description: Fine robes from Shimmerene are a very particular shade of gold. [PAWN_nameDef]'s family held the recipe and hands stained to the wrist in proof.

BackstoryDef.title: Firsthold vineyard steward
BackstoryDef.description: No bottle left a Firsthold vineyard without a seal, and no seal was granted until [PAWN_nameDef] had tasted it and scowled. Scowling was part of the title.

BackstoryDef.title: Crystal Tower gardener
BackstoryDef.description: Gardens surrounding the Crystal Tower have been laid out to a plan older than the Empire. [PAWN_nameDef] once moved a hedge by a hand's width and was formally warned.

BackstoryDef.title: Lillandril wine merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Selling wine to a Canonreeve means pretending the year matters more than the price. [PAWN_nameDef] could keep that up through nine courses.

BackstoryDef.title: genealogist
BackstoryDef.description: Marriages on Summerset need a clean lineage, and a clean lineage can be found for a fee. [PAWN_nameDef] found them often and kept the real records in a locked box.

BackstoryDef.title: harbor master
BackstoryDef.description: Merchants, smugglers and admirals all answer to the tide tables, and thus to [PAWN_nameDef]. A dock at Alinor is a small kingdom with worse smells.

BackstoryDef.title: master glassblower
BackstoryDef.description: Vases from [PAWN_nameDef]'s workshop were so thin that customers were afraid to breathe near them. Many of them broke anyway, which was good for repeat business.

BackstoryDef.title: shipyard carpenter
BackstoryDef.description: There are no straight lines on a Summerset ship. [PAWN_nameDef] worked by eye for sixty years, and could spot a wrong curve from across the slip.

BackstoryDef.title: ceremonial cook
BackstoryDef.description: Banquets on Alinor can last for days and include a course meant only to be looked at. [PAWN_nameDef] cooked it anyway, with full attention.

BackstoryDef.title: Dominion tax assessor
BackstoryDef.description: Bosmer villages have wonderfully creative accounts. [PAWN_nameDef] walked through a great many of them with a ledger and two armed friends.

BackstoryDef.title: tapestry weaver
BackstoryDef.description: An entire tapestry cycle on the fall of Aldmeris occupied [PAWN_nameDef] for most of a century. The last panel ran short of blue, and it remains a sore subject.

BackstoryDef.title: retired courtesan
BackstoryDef.description: Forty years of secrets were told to [PAWN_nameDef] by mer who assumed nobody was listening. Retirement came with a pension and nobody asked why.

BackstoryDef.title: Auridon quarry foreman
BackstoryDef.description: White marble for half of Alinor came out of [PAWN_nameDef]'s quarry. The other half came from competitors, about whom there was much to say.

BackstoryDef.title: Sunhold horse breeder
BackstoryDef.description: Bloodlines mean as much in the stable as in the great house. [PAWN_nameDef] kept better records on the horses, and frankly liked them more.

BackstoryDef.title: physician to the old
BackstoryDef.description: Altmer can live very long and complain the whole time. [PAWN_nameDef] treated the oldest families of Lillandril and heard every complaint, some of them twice.

BackstoryDef.title: temple cantor
BackstoryDef.description: Hymns to Auri-El are older than the temple walls, and [PAWN_nameDef] sang them in the same key every day for eighty years. Nobody ever noticed one small improvement.

BackstoryDef.title: Thalmor clerk
BackstoryDef.description: Arrest orders must be filed in triplicate. [PAWN_nameDef] never hurt anyone directly, as [PAWN_pronoun] liked to mention, and had very tidy handwriting.

BackstoryDef.title: Salache fisherman
BackstoryDef.description: Salache like [PAWN_nameDef] have kept Auridon fed since before the Dominion and been thanked for it about as often. The catch still comes in at dawn.

BackstoryDef.title: exile bookseller
BackstoryDef.description: Certain histories can no longer be printed on Summerset, so [PAWN_nameDef] sold them out of a shop in Wayrest. Thalmor visits were polite and came twice a year.

BackstoryDef.title: arbiter of manners
BackstoryDef.description: An insult at court may require weeks of study to fully appreciate. Families hired [PAWN_nameDef] to tell them whether they had been insulted, and how badly.
